integrity: The proof decomposes every increasing score into positive centered cumulative-cut indicators, computes their covariance matrix exactly, and applies the minimum cut correlation together with the Hilbert-space triangle inequality. Boundary sequences and Cauchy--Schwarz reconstruct the exact endpoint behavior. Exact-rational computation only replays finite instances.
scientific_limitations: The category probabilities are fixed and positive, and both score vectors are required to be strictly increasing.
The theorem treats deterministic recodings of one finite ordinal variable, not arbitrary couplings of two fixed margins.
Older association-array, isotonic-cone, or score-assignment literature may contain an equivalent normalized cone-angle statement.
title: Sharp correlation floor for two increasing codings of one ordinal variable
